title: Large Language Models Encode Semantics and Alignment in Linearly Separable Representations
reasoning: The paper investigates the internal representation of safety alignment and ethical deliberation in LLMs. It uses datasets and benchmarks to evaluate how models process moral judgments (e.g., questions from MMLU asking if a scenario is 'morally wrong') and how they refuse harmful or malicious requests, which are central to evaluating ethical behavior and alignment in models.
